dog.description_text:
A little feline friendship brings out the best in Mclain!

Mclain is a beautiful 3- year-old tabby who thrives in the company of other cats. She looks to her current feline roommates for reassurance, and their confidence has helped her blossom! Watching her friends interact with people has inspired Mclain to join in on the fun. She has discovered a love for wand toys after seeing her buddies play, and when the treats come out, she makes sure to get her fair share. Mclain also happily accepts pets on her head, cheeks and back while enjoying a snack.

Could Mclain be the perfect new friend for your feline family? Click the “Adopt Me” button to learn more about her!

*You can meet animals located at the ASPCA Adoption Center during our walk-in hours (daily, noon to 6 p.m.). We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
